visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a young child wearing glasses and yellow headphones inside an airplane cabin. On the tray table in front of her sits a purple reusable cup decorated with Zootopia character patterns. The lighting is warm and slightly dim, typical of a long-haul flight cabin. (2) The perspective shifts to a POV shot of an adult's hand picking up the purple cup. A flight attendant is seen standing in the aisle, attending to passengers. The tray table has a small bag of snacks and a tablet showing a video. (3) The flight attendant passes a small plastic cup containing a dark beverage to the person filming. The hand places the small cup on the tray table next to the large purple cup. (4) The person pours the contents of the small plastic cup into the larger purple reusable cup. The ice cubes clink as they drop. The person then removes the lid to show the drink inside, which fills only a portion of the larger vessel. (5) The camera returns to the child, who looks at the camera with a joyful, excited expression, her mouth open in a wow gesture. (6) The hand lifts the purple cup again, showing its design which features Nick Wilde and Judy Hopps. (7) A quick shot shows a man with a wide smile, wearing white headphones, holding the purple cup in front of him. (8) The final sequence shows a direct side-by-side comparison on the tray table between the large, branded reusable cup and the standard, much smaller airline plastic cup.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks in Mandarin with a friendly, casual tone over a continuous background drone of an airplane engine. The speech rate is moderate. A gentle, upbeat lo-fi acoustic guitar track plays at a low volume. (2) The male voice continues explaining a plan. There is a faint mechanical sound of a cup being adjusted on a plastic surface. The BGM remains steady and rhythmic. (3) A female voice with professional, clear articulation asks about adding ice in Mandarin. The male responds with a short English Yeah and Mandarin Thank you, his voice showing high valence and politeness. (4) The sound of liquid splashing and ice cubes clinking against the side of a cup is clearly audible, indicating a pour. The male voice expresses satisfaction as the action finishes. (5) The male voice chuckles and uses a higher pitch to show excitement. The ambient plane noise is constant in the background. (6) The male voice concludes by comparing the sizes of the two cups, using a playful tone and exaggerated emphasis on the word for large. The music remains consistent until the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the benefits and practical use of a large personal reusable cup while traveling on an airplane, emphasizing environmental friendliness and volume capacity compared to standard airline cups.
